PokerCoaching Cash Game Cheat Sheet
Cash Game Fundamentals
Mindset & Focus
Value Betting
• Think about the action on every street of every hand before you act.
• A value bet is made when you're confident you have the best hand and
• Do NOT play robotically.
expect your opponent to call with many weaker hands.
• Do NOT play the same generic, predicable style all the time
• Value bet weaker hands against loose players who rarely fold.
• You MUST get out of your comfort zone and exploit your opponents'
• Do Not value bet if opponents will fold most weaker hands.
weaknesses if you want to become a big winner.
• Avoid value betting on the turn and river against tight players who
• If you only pay attention to your own two cards, your position, and your
only continue with stronger hands and fold weaker ones.
chip stack, you are certain to fail in the long run.
• You MUST focus on your opponents.
• Pay attention to EVERY SINGLE HAND that takes place during your
session.
• Take mental notes about your opponents.
Preflop Strategy & Effective Stack Consideration
• If you have trouble remembering details, take notes for future
reference.
• Raise with a different range based on the effective stack size.
• Take notes on what each specific player does incorrectly.
• When calling a raise, ensure you are getting at least 10:1 implied odds
with small pocket pairs and 20:1 with suited connectors.
• With over 40 BBs, play more pots in position, especially against weak
post-flop players.
Pot Control
• Pot control to avoid getting blown off your hand and induce your
Adjust to Your Opponent
opponent to bluff.
• Do NOT pot control when your opponents will pay you off poorly.
• Adjust your strategy to exploit your specific opponents.
• Do NOT pot control when your opponents will rarely bluff the river.
• Exploit your opponents' tendencies.
• Always consider your opponent's range of hands rather than a specific
hand.

PokerCoaching Cash Game Cheat Sheet
Things to Focus On
Things to Focus on BEFORE Your Cash Session
Bankroll and Mindset
Sleep
Do I have the proper bankroll of at least 3,000 to 5,000 big blinds?
Did I get a full night's sleep?
If I don't, am I in the mindset to play properly as if I was properly bankrolled?
Breakfast
Do I have enough money on hand to re-buy as necessary
Did l eat a healthy breakfast?
Am l emotionally prepared to handle variance without going on tilt?
Study
Am I playing at stakes where I can make the best decisions without feeling
Did I study my previous games to find my errors?
pressured by the money?
Mental Focus
Do l have a plan for when to move up or down in stakes based on my results?
Is my mind clear such that playing poker is the ONLY thing that matters
now?
Things to Focus on DURING Each Hand of Your Session
My Opponent
Effective Stack Size
What do I know about my opponent?
How should I alter my play based on the effective stack size?
What are my opponent's tendencies?
Expectation
What can I do to take advantage of my opponent's tendencies?
How do I maximize my expectation for THIS hand?
What does my opponent know or think he knows about me?
Notes
Is my opponent doing anything to take advantage of me?
Am I writing down my difficult hands so I can review them later?
Things to Focus on AFTER Your Cash Session
Track Results
Discuss with Friends
Did I accurately record my session?
Did I discuss my hands with my friends and post them on the
The Good
PokerCoaching.com Discord?
Which aspects of my play were strong today?
Improve My Weaknesses
The Bad
What aspect of my game do I need to work on BEFORE my next cash
Where did I make mistakes or struggle in my decision-making?
game session?
Get Specific
Take Action
Were there any particular hands that gave me trouble?
What steps can I take IMMEDIATELY to ensure I play better next time?
APOKERCOACHING
